Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday to walk through your ingestion patterns and latency targets. I attached the estimate (PDF) and a short ops note that maps expected throughput to our Dedicated and Hosted options. Highlights: 
- 99th percentile target of ~120ms maps to our Dedicated small cluster; estimated monthly cost: $18k–22k depending on token volume.
- Prefix caching and a KV strategy we discussed should reduce token cost by an estimated 16–22%.

Next steps I proposed on the call: confirm ROI window with procurement and pick a 1-week pilot window. If helpful, I can do a 20-minute walkthrough of the estimate with procurement to surface implementation assumptions.

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_LucentHealth_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Can you confirm you received this and whether procurement would prefer a summary deck or the full estimate for their packet?

Thanks,
